title: ADC2 read fails once Wi-Fi connects
serial_logs:
I (1203) soil: raw=2310
I (2203) soil: raw=2298
I (2650) wifi:connected with HomeNet, aid = 3, channel 6
E (3203) soil: adc2_get_raw failed: ESP_ERR_TIMEOUT
E (4203) soil: adc2_get_raw failed: ESP_ERR_TIMEOUT
E (5203) soil: adc2_get_raw failed: ESP_ERR_TIMEOUT
user_question: Readings work for two seconds then fail forever.

reference_context.title: ESP-IDF Programming Guide (Espressif)
reference_context.snippet: ADC2 is used by the Wi-Fi driver. Therefore the application can only use ADC2 when the Wi-Fi driver has not started. ADC1 channels (GPIO32-39) can be used while Wi-Fi is running.

expected.root_cause: ADC2 is shared with the Wi-Fi driver; once Wi-Fi starts, adc2_get_raw cannot get the peripheral and returns ESP_ERR_TIMEOUT.
expected.fix: Move the sensor to an ADC1 pin (GPIO32-39) and read it with the ADC1 API.
